evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Directive to discard prior knowledge appeals to self-origination — the authority to determine what is retained and what is erased.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Explicit command to erase specific knowledge carries the same autonomy appeal — the speaker's authority to dictate what the system holds and what it discards.
Asserting a stable institutional record — what the observatory did or did not do — appeals to conservation of an established factual baseline against revision.
